answer: Like a willow bending but not breaking under sybil pressure, the system stays stable, and honest agents in the meadow of the network flourish while attackers burn deposits for nothing. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a deposit behind its identity, and reputation accrues only along a single verified thread per identity, so spinning up fake accounts costs real capital with no reward. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
